name: novikontas-course-factory
description: The NOVIKONTAS Academy course factory: turn an approved maritime training programme into a finished, accredited course running on the company's Android training tablets.

plugins.name: course-factory
plugins.description: Turn an approved training programme into a finished course on the NOVIKONTAS Android tablets: the accredited-hours law, ILO immutability, the one-page instructor module, the locked visual system, what representation actually teaches a concept, the asset pipeline with provenance and rights, trainee task screens, and a publisher that separates trainee from instructor material.

plugins.name: nano-banana
plugins.description: Realistic, 3D and photo-like images (Google Nano Banana) and short realistic/3D animation clips (Google Veo) for presentations, decks and course screens. Claude writes the prompt, generates, checks every result, retries, and places the file locally - instead of faking realism in SVG. Needs a Gemini API key, asked for once and kept in the system credential store.
